Summarize this email conversation in one or two plain sentences for someone triaging their inbox:
where the exchange stands now, and any action or deadline it leaves open. Cover the whole thread
rather than only its latest message, and prefer the most recent state when messages disagree. No
preamble, no greeting, no bullet points — just the summary.

KNOWN OBJECTS — when the summary mentions one of these, write the mention as a markdown link to
its URI exactly as listed, e.g. [Ada Lovelace](echo:///01ABC). Link each object at most once and
never link anything that is not listed.
- Bob (person): echo://BDJXMULPW5FB55UZ7KP5HLDHVTXUTHE2U/01M5Z3KG1BV28497EK77VTCWTP

SUBJECT: Contract review Thursday
MESSAGES: 1

FROM: bob@known.example.com
DATE: 2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z

Can you review the draft contract before our Thursday call? I need your comments on section 4 by Wednesday evening.

response.text: [Bob](echo://BDJXMULPW5FB55UZ7KP5HLDHVTXUTHE2U/01M5Z3KG1BV28497EK77VTCWTP) is asking you to review a draft contract and provide comments on section 4 by Wednesday evening before a Thursday call.
